test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 4).
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Amit, Bunty, Vaibhav, Harshit, Pulkit and Gagan are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Bunty is the immediate neighbour of Harshit and Vaibhav. Amit is the immediate neighbour of Pulkit and Vaibhav. Who is the immediate neighbour of Amit and Gagan?
solution: Six friends** Amit, Bunty, Vaibhav, Harshit, Pulkit and Gagan** are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1. Bunty is the immediate neighbour of Harshit and Vaibhav. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba13b85a96ff7390a2f54efba249ef2e75634fab4349799fdfb0b7079e1bdf49.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/654e30fa5d05aa0abee1d33a3a170b14a525c9c9b464aa09ef2f241c9a23fd20.png] 2. Amit is the immediate neighbour of Pulkit and Vaibhav.
